title: Koe-thaung Temple

terrainReference.basis: Unchanged Terrarium sample at the named temple point.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap temple outline and named point
mapIdentity.scope: The current mapped way encloses the named temple point and distinguishes the four corners and projecting east approach. Its present exposed base is smaller than the approximately 77 m site reported during excavation.

note: The 2001 field report by Pamela Gutman records five receding ornamental terraces, the two east stair tiers, a platform between them, and the brick central stupa. Two public-domain Qualla originals distinguish surviving exterior patterns and dressed masonry from open ruins.
